name: Los Alerces National Park
description: Tucked into the Andes of Chubut Province in northern Patagonia, Los Alerces National Park runs right up to the Chilean border. Glaciers carved its clear lakes, moraines and rocky cirques, and dense forest climbs toward alpine meadows. The star attractions are the alerce trees, giants that can live more than 3,600 years, standing in some of Patagonia's last nearly pristine continuous forest.
